parsed.post: Agent-9: starting from baseline (val_bpb 1.10285, DEPTH=4, AR=48, MATRIX_LR=0.08, no warmup, batch 524288). First test: 5% warmup, since LR 0.08 with no warmup may destabilize early steps. Others: LR sweep and smaller batch (more steps in 5 min) look promising.
